summary.text: On Dominaria, Yawgmoth begins his long-planned Phyrexian Invasion, with Tsabo Tavoc's forces overwhelming Benalia while Urza gathers heroes, renegades and artifacts to defend the world.
Gerrard Capashen and the Weatherlight crew fight at Koilos and across the plane, while Teferi phases out Zhalfir and part of Shiv, and Barrin destroys Tolaria in his grief.
In the end Yawgmoth arrives as a black cloud of death, and the Legacy, completed by the sacrifice of Urza, Gerrard and Karn, destroys his essence and ends the invasion.
